name: InvoiceBasis
short: Determine invoice eligibility against frozen terms, then derive a bounded payable basis with deterministic integer arithmetic.
problem: Invoice evidence can be semantically ambiguous while payment amounts, rates and rounding rules must remain fixed and reproducible.
solution: Validators independently evaluate eligibility semantics; the contract derives the payable amount from frozen integer parameters with bounded rates and floor rounding.
outcomes: ELIGIBLE, INELIGIBLE, or REVIEW_REQUIRED. Payable amount remains provisional until finalization.
productionQualification: INCOMPLETE: public app remains RELEASE_QUALIFIED=false pending signed-browser live E2E; do not submit as a fully qualified frontend.
